item.title: [News] OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
item.description: OpenAI and Google Cloud are launching Gemini’s frontier models and Codex workflows in the Google Cloud Marketplace, enabling users to embed advanced AI capabilities directly into their cloud environment.

item.title: [News] Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data
item.description: OpenAI, PerturbAI, and Scripps Research deployed thousands of distributed AI agents to sift through massive brain‑cell datasets, identifying novel research leads. The work showcases scalable AI‑driven hypothesis generation rather than a new product or security update.

item.title: [News] The Download: introducing the Impossible issue
item.description: MIT Technology Review’s weekly newsletter introduces a new themed edition called the Impossible issue, aiming to explore imaginative tech concepts.

item.title: [News] ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries as over 100,000 advertisers have used the platform
item.description: OpenAI has rolled out ChatGPT Ads to 26 new countries, enabling over 100,000 advertisers to target users within the chat interface. The expansion increases the platform’s commercial footprint but does not directly alter core IT tools.

item.title: [News] AI promises productivity, but for managers, it’s mostly a headache for now
item.description: A TechCrunch survey indicates that over half of managers are struggling to assess employee productivity following AI adoption. The study highlights growing concerns about the managerial impact of AI tools.
